fields.name: PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi
fields.description:
Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN): Provides ₹6,000 annually to eligible landholding farmers in three installments of ₹2,000 each, transferred directly to bank accounts.
https://pmkisan.gov.in/

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
fields.description: A crop insurance scheme providing financial support and coverage to farmers against losses due to natural calamities, pests, or diseases.

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
fields.description: Improves irrigation efficiency and water availability.
fields.benefits:
Drip irrigation subsidy
Water conservation
Better yield

fields.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
fields.description: Supports solar pumps and renewable energy use in agriculture.
fields.benefits:
Up to 60% subsidy
Solar irrigation
Extra income via power sale

fields.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
fields.description: Provides soil nutrient reports and fertilizer recommendations.
fields.benefits:
Free soil testing
Balanced fertilizer use
Increased productivity

fields.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
fields.description: Online agricultural market connecting mandis across India.
fields.benefits:
Transparent pricing
Online trading
Wider market reach

fields.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
fields.description: Promotes organic farming through cluster-based approach.
fields.benefits:
Financial assistance
Organic certification
Training support
fields.eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming

fields.name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
fields.description: Promotes use of modern agricultural machinery.
fields.benefits:
40–60% subsidy
Access to modern equipment
Reduced labor effort

fields.name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission
fields.benefits:
Subsidy on bee colonies
Training programs
Additional income source

fields.name: Blue Revolution (Fisheries)
fields.description: Promotes fisheries sector growth and infrastructure.
fields.benefits:
Fish farming support
Infrastructure development
Employment generation

fields.name: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
fields.benefits:
Soil & water conservation
Climate adaptation
Sustainable farming

fields.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
fields.benefits:
Financial support
Infrastructure development
Innovation promotion

fields.name: Integrated Scheme on Agriculture Marketing (ISAM)
fields.benefits:
Market yards
Storage facilities
Improved logistics

fields.name: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Shetkari Karjamukti Yojana
fields.description: A Maharashtra government scheme aimed at providing financial relief to farmers by waiving certain eligible agricultural loans and improving their economic stability.
fields.benefits:
Loan waiver up to a specified limit
Reduces financial burden
Helps farmers restart agricultural activities
fields.eligibility:
Farmers from Maharashtra
Must have taken crop loans from eligible institutions
Small & marginal farmers prioritized

fields.name: Bhausaheb Fundkar Falbag Lagwad Yojana
fields.description: Promotes horticulture by encouraging farmers to cultivate fruit orchards with financial assistance.
fields.benefits:
Subsidy for fruit plantation
Encourages long-term income crops
Technical guidance support
fields.eligibility:
Farmers in Maharashtra
Land suitable for horticulture

fields.name: Rajya Krishi Yantrikikaran Yojana
fields.description: State-level scheme promoting farm mechanization through subsidies on agricultural equipment.
fields.benefits:
Subsidy on tractors & tools
Reduces labor dependency
Increases productivity
fields.eligibility:
Farmers in Maharashtra
Individual or group farmers
